name: Hobie Brown
distinction: A Spider-Man from Earth-138. The Hobie Brown of other worlds has also used the Prowler identity. This record is the Spider-Punk version.
summary: Hobie Brown is Spider-Punk, a guitar-smashing Spider-Man from a fascist Britain. Daniel Kaluuya voices the film version in Across the Spider-Verse. The comic Hobie and the film Hobie should not be treated as one continuous life.
firstAppearance: Spider-Punk debuted in The Amazing Spider-Man (vol. 3) #10 (2015).
